item.title: Appeal after burglary at a Hockley shop
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a Nottingham shop was burgled. Cash from inside a till was stolen from K-Pop Korner, in Heathcoat Street, Hockley. A window above the shop door was smashed during the break in, which was reported at 7am on Wednesday (3 December). Officers are carrying out CCTV enquiries and forensic analysis […]

item.title: Victorian Papplewick Pumping Station has plans for next year
item.description: The director of the most complete Victorian pumping station in the country has big hopes for the site in the new year – after it was removed from Historic England’s Heritage at Risk Register following a £500,000 restoration project. item.title: Burton Joyce: Railway footpath crossing where boy died will close until at least May 2026

item.title: Man who abused and assaulted partner is jailed after Court of Appeal ruling
item.description: A man who subjected his partner to a campaign of abuse during which he broke her arm has been jailed after a court ruled his sentence was unduly lenient. Luke Pollard was handed a two-year suspended prison sentence at Nottingham Crown Court in June after admitting causing grievous bodily harm and controlling and coercive behaviour. […]

item.title: Mobile library service for Sherwood as new library opening delayed
item.description: Nottingham City Libraries is pleased to announce that a temporarily mobile library service will begin visiting Sherwood from Saturday 13 December, ensuring residents can continue to enjoy library services while we await the opening of the brand-new Sherwood Library in 2026.
